title: Germany and the Ottoman Empire signed a treaty of alliance on 2 August 1914
summary: Germany and the Ottoman Empire concluded an alliance treaty on 2 August 1914.
body: Avalon prints a treaty of alliance between Germany and Turkey dated 2 August 1914. The alliance is a document of the July crisis's aftermath. It does not by itself assign guilt for the war, which remains a historians' argument on another card. The wording on the page includes: "1700 - 1799 19th Century 1800 - 1899 20th Century 1900 - 1999 21st Century 2000 - Treaty of Alliance Between Germany and Turkey 2 August, 1914 Constantinople, August 2, 1914 1. The two contracting parties agree to observe strict neutrality in regard to the present conflict between Austria-Hungary and Serbia. 2. In case Russia should intervene with active military measures, and".
